data.body: Found by the dedupe gate of LK-conflict-probe-gates. ddflow/services/metrics/lockgit.py GitProbes.conflicts runs `git merge-tree --write-tree` and maps exit 0/1 to a bool, as ddflow/services/probe.py (LK-conflict-probe) now does with more care (git 2.43 129 fallback to a scratch merge, deadline, tip checks). Make GitProbes.conflicts call probe.run(...).result (clean->False, conflict->True, unavailable->None) so the two cannot drift; test with a fake runner in the metrics-locks tests. Mind the cost: probe.run adds rev-parse and --version calls per pair.
